title: Infantry
basis: R = as printed in the book. Fields marked uncertain / judged / *Note carry the reader's doubts; printed totals are kept even where parts do not add up. Re-checked against the book on 15 Nov 2026: chartStrength = the figure printed in a chart box (units and inline children); weapons / vehicles printed in or under a box sit on that box node; an inline child may carry seeUnit (the matching unit defined in this or another file, a cross-reference only, not part of the hierarchy) and nested children for the sub-boxes this chart prints; a child weapon count is per box unless its note says it covers all the boxes of that child.
pageNote: Pages cited are the numbers printed on each page (PDF page = printed page - 599). The CONTENTS numbers run one ahead of the printed numbers from Lt Cdo Bn (623) and from Mjd Bn (639) onwards (e.g. Chars of Inf Wpns listed at 648, printed 647-649).

mtnTime.title: Formula for Working out Time in Mtns
mtnTime.general: Dists in mtns are measured in term of time rather than dist; due attn must be paid to the addl time req for ascent and descent.
routeRules: The route should not fol/cross a cliff, bluff or a re-entrant.
It should preferably be along the ridge lines, valleys and the ascent/descent should be along gradual slopes or existing trs.
